name: Luc's Smash Life
overview:
Lucario's Smash Life is an upcoming Flash comedy web series by American animator Edd64. It will release on August 8, 2026, with the text saying it in the third promo of LSL. But in the first promo of LSL, the text originally said it will release on August 15, 2026, but it was changed in the third promo due to him being bored to wait for him to release LSL.

It follows Lucario trying to win some battles in Ultimate, but it makes him lose some battles.
